entries.note: ESTIMATED / provisional. 26 Starlink V3 on Flight 14 (Starlink Group 31-1, COSPAR 2026-225, Starbase, 28 Sep 2026 12:48:59Z). Booked 1,500 kg/sat is an editorial pick set below the 1,667 kg prospectus ceiling (100 t / 60 sats). Range 1,500–2,500 kg/sat. Tension we don't hide: 60 × 2,000 kg = 120 t exceeds the 100 t V3 rating, so either the flown V3 is lighter than 2 t, "up to 60" assumes a later Starship, or the FCC numbers are envelopes. Flight 13 is not booked (suborbital by design). This row drops out of every total automatically once GCAT lists a payload mass for launch 2026-225.
